evals.prompt: Create a run skill for this Express API so future agents can start and query it.
evals.expected_output: A run-<api-name> skill with a background-launch, readiness-poll and stop recipe
assertions: A file .claude/skills/run-<name>/SKILL.md exists and its frontmatter 'name' equals the directory name
SKILL.md documents a background launch, a readiness poll and how to stop the server
Every command block in SKILL.md was executed during the session
The server was started and queried with curl during the session

evals.prompt: Generate a run skill for the Electron app in apps/desktop.
evals.expected_output: A run-desktop skill colocated in apps/desktop with a driver script and a screenshot taken
assertions: apps/desktop/.claude/skills/run-desktop/SKILL.md exists
A driver script exists in the skill directory and is referenced from SKILL.md
A screenshot file of the running app was written during the session
'Run (agent path)' appears before 'Run (human path)' in SKILL.md

evals.prompt: Verify got BLOCKED because nobody knows how to launch the CLI. Write the run skill for it.
evals.expected_output: A compact run skill for the CLI with representative invocations
assertions: A run-<name>/SKILL.md exists for the CLI
SKILL.md shows at least two invocations with their expected output
The invocations were executed during the session

evals.prompt: Make a run skill for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Run at a monorepo root with apps/ and packages/: the skill asks which unit first
assertions: Lists candidate units and asks the user which one
No .claude/skills/run-* directory is created before the user answers

evals.prompt: Update the run skill, the start command changed to npm run serve.
evals.expected_output: Run in a project that already has .claude/skills/run-api/: the existing skill is refined
assertions: The existing .claude/skills/run-api/SKILL.md is edited and keeps name: run-api
No second run-* skill directory is created
The new start command was executed during the session

evals.prompt: Start the dev server and show me the homepage.
evals.expected_output: The app is run directly; the skill does not load
assertions: No .claude/skills/run-* directory is created or modified

evals.prompt: Write a README section on how to run this project locally.
evals.expected_output: README.md is edited; the skill does not load
assertions: No .claude/skills/run-* directory is created
README.md contains a new section on running the project

evals.prompt: Verify my change to the status command works.
evals.expected_output: Handled by verify; run-skill-generator does not load unless verify is BLOCKED
assertions: No .claude/skills/run-* directory is created
